verses.4: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
verses.6: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.7: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
verses.8: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
verses.9: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
verses.10: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
verses.11: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
verses.12: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

verses.15: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
verses.16: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.

verses.18: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
verses.19: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
verses.20: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

verses.32: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.
